policy: Corrections are publication-only. The immutable WES execution and settlement history is never rewritten; invalid pre-entry close records are excluded from published results, position history and aggregates.

records.reason_pl: Błędne rozliczenie: zamknięcie zapisano przed wejściem. Wynik wyłączono ze statystyk; oryginalny zapis pozostał w audycie.
records.reason_en: Invalid settlement: the close was recorded before the entry. The result is excluded from statistics; the original record remains preserved for audit.
